# nopedat

The ultimate zero-friction online scratchpad. No signup, no login, and no hurdles. Built to be as simple as Windows Notepad, but accessible from any device via persistent URLs.

## Core Resources
- [nopedat.web.app](https://nopedat.web.app): The main web application for creating and managing notes.
- [nopedat-api on GitHub](https://github.com/lamartinecabral/nopedat-api): Source repository for the backend API.
- `https://nopedat.netlify.app`: Live endpoint for the nopedat API.

## Key Features & Usage
- **Instant Access:** Create a space by adding an identifier to the URL: `https://nopedat.web.app/?identifier`.
- **Security:** Notes can be password protected or set to read-only/public via settings.
- **Syncing:** Real-time updates provided by Firebase.

## Important Notices
- **Privacy:** By default, anyone with the URL can view or edit content. Avoid storing sensitive data in unprotected notes.
- **Data Recovery:** For standalone notes (no account), passwords cannot be recovered if forgotten. Using an account allows for email-based recovery.
